tools.name: calculate_elo
tools.description: Estimate a player's new Elo rating after a single game with the Elo formula. Pure arithmetic, no chess engine. The system field picks a K-factor default for FIDE, Chess.com or Lichess, but the result is an Elo estimate: Chess.com and Lichess use Glicko ratings, so their real rating changes differ.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_daily_puzzle" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
